**14** ## Vale Base Metals Operations ### **North Atlantic Operations** : **Sudbury, Ontario** - 100+ year old mining and processing (smelting and - refining) operation - One of the largest integrated mining operations in - the world making high purity carbonyl nickel products : **Port Colborne, Ontario** - Facility for cobalt refining and precious metals - upgrading - Commissioned in 1918 : **Thompson, Manitoba** - Integrated nickel mining, milling, smelting and - refining facility - Operating since 1961 - produces highest quality - nickel plating product on the market Sudbury Operations
Thompson Operations
**16** ### **North Atlantic Operations (cont.)** : **Voisey’s Bay, Newfoundland & Labrador** - Single open-pit nickel-copper-cobalt sulphide mine - - feeds a dedicated mill and concentrator - Located in coastal Labrador and has been - operating since 2005. : **Long Harbour, Newfoundland & Labrador** Voisey’s Bay Mine
- Construction of a hydrometallurgical facility - underway - Capacity of 50,000tpy of nickel and associated - copper and cobalt that will process Voisey’s Bay concentrate Construction at Long Harbour
**17** ### **North Atlantic Operations (cont.)** : **Acton, England** - Built in 1924, one of the world's major refiners - of platinum-group metals (PGMs) platinum, palladium, rhodium, ruthenium and iridium, as well as gold and silver : **Clydach, Wales** - Refinery produces approximately 40,000 - tonnes per year of high purity carbonyl nickel pellets and powders Acton Refinery
Clydach refinery
**18** ### **Asia Pacific & Africa Operations** : **PT Vale Indonesia, Indonesia** - •Largest nickel laterite smelter in the world •Ore from open-pit mines is processed into a nickel matte intermediate product for shipment to refineries in Japan : **Vale New Caledonia, South Pacific** - •Vertically integrated nickel refinery for processing of limonitic ores - •Annual capacity of 57,000 tonnes of contained nickel and 4,500 tpy cobalt •Majority

of the nickel produced is in the form of nickel oxide (NiO), with the balance being nickel hydroxide cake (NHC) Processing plant, Indonesia
NHC product at VNC
**19** ### **Asia Pacific & Africa Operations (cont.)** : **Matsuzaka, Japan** - •Plant processes matte supplied by PTVI to produce intermediate and refined nickel products **Dalian, China** : - •Produces utility nickel for local stainless steel industry using nickel oxide sinter to be supplied primarily by Vale New Caledonia **TNRC, Taiwan** : - •Produces utility nickel for the domestic market; tonimet and nickel oxide feed is sourced primarily from Vale Japan **KNC, Korea** : - •Vale is a minority shareholder in Korea Nickel Corporation (KNC) which owns a utility nickel plant in Korea **20** ### **Asia Pacific & Africa Operations (cont.)** : **Lubambe, Zambia** - •Underground mine project being developed through a joint venture with African Minerals - •Achieved first production in October 2012, and will produce 45,000 tpy of copper in concentrate Onзa Puma
**21** ##### **South Atlantic Operations (Page 1 of 2)** : **Sossego, Brazil** - •Vale’s first open-pit copper mine in the South Atlantic - •Facility consists of a mine, mill and concentrator •Concentrate contains on average 120,000 tpy of copper, as well as 104,000 oz of gold per year : **Salobo, Brazil** - •Largest copper deposit ever discovered in Brazil - •Greenfield, open-pit mining project with a mill and concentrator, producing a copper concentrate •Project being developed in two phases, with Salobo I producing 100,000 tpy of copper in concentrate, and Salobo II doubling production Sossego mine site
Salobo mine site
**22** ##### **South Atlantic Operations (Page 2 of 2)** : **Onзa Puma, Brazil** - •Vale’s first nickel project in Brazil - •Plant consists of two parallel rotary kiln – electric furnace lines - •First nickel produced in April 2011, production restart anticipated Q4 2013 : **Tres Valles, Chile** - •Vale’s first project in Chile •Operation consists of two copper oxide mines, and a solvent extraction and electrowinning (SXEW) plant capable of producing 18,500 tpy of copper cathodes Onca Puma Operations
Tres Valles copper cathodes
**23** ## Asia Pacific Nickel Context ##### **The Asia Pacific region is important from both a nickel supply and demand perspective** **Asia Pacific share of global primary nickel supply/demand (2012)** **Source: INSG, Vale** #### **New Caledonia i

s a key supplier of nickel** **New Caledonia share of global primary nickel supply/demand (2012)** **Source: INSG, Vale** #### **Asia Pacific mine supply has been the key source of new nickel growth with its world share growing from 37% in 2009 to 57% in 2012** - Mine supply from Asia Pacific region has increased significantly since 2009 - Indonesia and Philippines nickel ores have been the primary contributor to this growth as they feed growing demand from Chinese NPI producers - Region remains key future supply of high grade laterite ores **Source: INSG** - Indonesia ore regulations taking effect in 2014 #### **Asia Pacific region dominates global nickel mine production** |**Potential mine**| |---| |**production from New**| |**Caledonia by 2015/16**| |**with ramp- up of VNC &**| |**Koniambo**| **Source: INSG, Vale analysis** #### **Asia Pacific region remains critical with significant resources available in the project pipeline** **Source: SNL Metals Economics Group, Vale analysis** #### **Source of refined nickel in Asia Pacific is predominantly laterite** ###### **Refined Nickel by Ore Type:** Source: Vale estimates
#### **Refined supply growth has come from China, but will increasingly come from New Caledonia as VNC and Koniambo ramp up** **Source: INSG** - Refined production from Asia Pacific region has increased significantly over the past 5 years, driven primarily by the production of Chinese NPI - Refined nickel production in South Korea came online in 2008 using New Caledonian ore - New Caledonia to play important role in further refined supply expansion as VNC and Koniambo ramp up #### **New Caledonia will become one of the largest producers of refined nickel after successful ramp-up of VNC and Koniambo** **Source: INSG, Vale analysis** #### **Asia Pacific countries have been key drivers of nickel demand growth over the past 50 years with China especially important over the past 10** ###### **Nickel Demand by Region** China
